answers.2:
visudo -cf /tmp/alice.draft          # syntax error 가 나온다. 규칙에 '=' 가 빠졌다
sed -i 's/ALL (root)/ALL=(root)/' /tmp/alice.draft
visudo -cf /tmp/alice.draft          # parsed OK
cp /tmp/alice.draft /etc/sudoers.d/alice
chmod 0440 /etc/sudoers.d/alice
sudo -l -U alice                     # (root) /usr/bin/id 가 보인다
answers.3:
echo '%ops ALL=(ALL) ALL' > /etc/sudoers.d/ops
chmod 0440 /etc/sudoers.d/ops
visudo -cf /etc/sudoers.d/ops
sudo -l -U carol    # (ALL) ALL
sudo -l -U dave     # not allowed to run sudo

visudo -c                           # frank.rules 는 목록에 없다(건너뜀)
cat /etc/sudoers.d/README | head   # '.' 가 들어간 이름과 ~ 로 끝나는 이름은 건너뜀
mv /etc/sudoers.d/frank.rules /etc/sudoers.d/frank
sudo -l -U frank                    # (root) /usr/bin/id
answers.8:
cat /etc/sudoers.d/deploy
echo 'deploy ALL=(root) NOPASSWD: /usr/local/bin/restart-app.sh' > /etc/sudoers.d/deploy
visudo -cf /etc/sudoers.d/deploy
su deploy -s /bin/bash -c 'sudo -n /usr/local/bin/restart-app.sh'   # 성공
su deploy -s /bin/bash -c 'sudo -n /usr/bin/id'                      # a password is required
